facts.text: The hotel is set against the backdrop of the Han River and Mount Namsan.
facts.excerpt: is set against the stunning backdrop of Han River and Mount Namsan

facts.text: The hotel is a 20-floor glass building on the slopes of Namsan in Hannam-dong.
facts.excerpt: a 20-floor glass structure nesting on the slopes of Namsan

facts.text: The hotel spreads across 23 landscaped acres, giving it the feel of a leisure resort in the heart of the city.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Seoul spreads across 23 landscaped acres—lending it the feel of a leisure resort in the heart of the city.

facts.text: The hotel is minutes from downtown Seoul, Myeongdong and Itaewon.
facts.excerpt: being minutes from downtown Seoul, Myeongdong, and Itaewon

facts.text: The hotel is close to cultural attractions such as the Leeum Samsung Museum of Art and Bukchon Hanok Village.
facts.excerpt: cultural attractions like Leeum Samsung Museum of Art, Bukchon Hanok Village and much more

facts.text: Guest rooms have interiors accented with Korean cultural inspiration.
facts.excerpt: offer stylish interiors accented with Korean cultural inspiration

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of the Seoul skyline.
facts.excerpt: modern rooms featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, offering magnificent panoramic views of the Seoul skyline

facts.text: Room decor includes black-and-white fish paintings, hanok photographs and geometric wood patterns reminiscent of bojagi wrapping cloths.
facts.excerpt: black-and-white fish paintings, hanok (traditional Korean houses) photographs, and geometric wood patterns reminiscent of bojagi (traditional Korean wrapping cloths)

facts.text: River View rooms on the higher floors look out over the Han River and the city.
facts.excerpt: Take in stunning views of the Han River and the city in this modernistic room featuring one king bed with a sofa bed and located on the higher floors.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has panoramic views of the Han River and Mount Namsan.
facts.excerpt: offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Han River and Mount Namsan

facts.text: Club Olympus wellness center has a sauna, an indoor pool, an outdoor pool with a whirlpool, and squash and tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: The center features a sauna, indoor pool, outdoor pool with a whirlpool, as well as squash and tennis courts.

facts.text: The outdoor swimming pool overlooks the Han River.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Han River, the huge 35x14 m sized outdoor swimming pool

facts.text: The indoor pool on the Garden Level has a nature-friendly interior with trees.
facts.excerpt: The nature-friendly interior, combined with the trees, creates an exotic atmosphere.

facts.text: In winter the outdoor pool becomes an ice skating rink.
facts.excerpt: an outdoor pool that transforms into an ice skating rink come winter

facts.text: The Spa has nine independent treatment suites and a European botanical garden concept.
facts.excerpt: nine independent treatment suites and the European botanical garden concept

facts.text: 322 Sowol-ro is the hotel's gourmet alley with four restaurants: Steak House, Teppan, Kauri and Tenkai.
facts.excerpt: Take a walk down 322 Sowol-ro, our unique gourmet alley where you’ll find four exquisite restaurants, each with its own distinct personality and cuisine: Steak House, Teppan, Kauri and Tenkai.

facts.text: The Gallery lounge has art, music and large floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by the art, music, and natural light that floods the area through large floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: Grand Club access includes a dedicated concierge, daily breakfast buffet, and evening cocktails and canapes.
facts.excerpt: the exclusive space includes a dedicated concierge, daily breakfast buffet, and evening cocktails and canapes

facts.text: Children under 13 are not allowed in the Grand Club Lounge during evening cocktails.
facts.excerpt: children under the age of 13 will be restricted from entering the Grand Club Lounge during evening cocktails

facts.text: Walking up the hill to the hotel is steep and takes about 20 minutes.
facts.excerpt: The ascent up the hill is steep and takes about 20 minutes

facts.text: The hotel has a kids' lounge, which is unsupervised.
facts.excerpt: Parents should be aware that the space is unsupervised.

facts.text: Certain room amenities are discontinued or only available on request as part of the hotel's sustainability commitment.
facts.excerpt: certain room amenities are discontinued or only available upon request

facts.text: The ice rink is described as the most romantic ice-skating experience in the city.
facts.excerpt: Our massive rink offers the warmest and most romantic ice-skating experience in the city
